actual_ingestion_proof.note: Live web article inspected and provider licence/docs checked. This is not a real Wikipedia source-body ingest; local synthetic XML exercises converter until one exact original snapshot/host-approved fetch arrives.

policy: One of everything = one qualified concept identity, many source revision/evidence/media relationships.
Distinct physical object, shape class, model, namespace, revision and version must not fuse solely on a shared label.
Keep original bytes when offline exact reproduction is required; compact semantic graph does not reproduce unretained prose.
No illegal third-party redistribution; Wikipedia licensing includes attribution and share alike; media independent.
CDX/Memento/Wayback availability says only a capture exists and when, not permission or accuracy.
Traditional open-source software licences differ from Wikipedia content licences and Wikidata structured-data rights.
Do not modify accepted CGX carriers or create a new CCC.cgx root before Object_ID and DBR validation.
